sentences.text: Clarence Thomas -LRB- born June 23 , 1948 -RRB- is an American judge , lawyer , and government official who currently serves as an Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States .	Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States	Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States	Associate Justice	Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States	Supreme Court of the United States	Supreme Court of the United States
Thomas succeeded Thurgood Marshall and is the second African American to serve on the court .	Thurgood Marshall	Thurgood Marshall	African American	African American

Thomas grew up in Savannah , Georgia , and was educated at the College of the Holy Cross and at Yale Law School .	Georgia	Georgia (U.S. state)	College of the Holy Cross	College of the Holy Cross	Yale Law School	Yale Law School

In 1974 , he was appointed an Assistant Attorney General in Missouri and subsequently practiced law there in the private sector .	Assistant Attorney General	Missouri Attorney General	Missouri	Missouri

In 1979 , he became a legislative assistant to Senator John Danforth -LRB- R-MO -RRB- and in 1981 was appointed Assistant Secretary for Civil Rights at the U.S. Department of Education .	legislative assistant	legislative assistant	John Danforth	John Danforth	R	Republican Party (United States)	MO	Missouri	U.S. Department of Education	U.S. Department of Education

In 1982 , President Ronald Reagan appointed Thomas Chairman of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission -LRB- EEOC -RRB- .	Equal Employment Opportunity Commission	Equal Employment Opportunity Commission	Ronald Reagan	Ronald Reagan

In 1990 , President George H. W. Bush nominated Thomas for a seat on the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit .	George H. W. Bush	George H. W. Bush	United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit	United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit
He served in that role for 16 months and on July 1 , 1991 , was nominated by Bush to fill Marshall 's seat on the United States Supreme Court .	United States Supreme Court	United States Supreme Court

Thomas 's confirmation hearings were bitter and intensely fought , centering on an accusation that he had sexually harassed attorney Anita Hill , a subordinate at the Department of Education and subsequently at the EEOC .	sexually harassed	sexual harassment	Anita Hill	Anita Hill
The U.S. Senate ultimately confirmed Thomas by a vote of 52 -- 48 .	U.S. Senate	U.S. Senate

Since joining the court , Thomas has taken a textualist approach , seeking to uphold the original meaning of the United States Constitution and statutes .	textualist	textualist	original meaning	original meaning	United States Constitution	United States Constitution
He is generally viewed as the most conservative member of the court .	conservative	conservatism in the United States
Thomas is also known for his practice of rarely speaking during oral arguments .
